hazards.name: Driveway Conflict
hazards.description: A garage door indicates a location where vehicles cross the pedestrian walkway to access the building.

interventions.title: Shared Street (Woonerf) Design
interventions.description: Redesign the street as a shared space with level surfaces, textured paving, and clear signage to prioritize pedestrians over vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lamps to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during low-light conditions.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Install traffic calming measures to ensure vehicles maintain very low speeds in this narrow residential environment.

interventions.title: Obstruction Removal
interventions.description: Relocate trash bins and other temporary objects to a designated storage area off the main pedestrian path to maintain clear width.

interventions.title: Driveway Delineation
interventions.description: Use contrasting pavement materials or clear markings to define the pedestrian right-of-way across the garage entrance.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction and Expansion
interventions.description: Install a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk of at least 6 feet in width that is free of utility poles and other obstructions.

interventions.title: Parking Management
interventions.description: Implement and enforce parking restrictions to prevent vehicles from encroaching on pedestrian walkways.

interventions.title: Delineated Pedestrian Path
interventions.description: Use contrasting pavement materials or high-visibility markings to clearly define the pedestrian through-zone across the driveway areas.

interventions.title: Pavement Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the walkway to eliminate cracks and provide a smooth, accessible surface for all users.

interventions.title: Temporary Pedestrian Access
interventions.description: Require the construction site to provide a protected, ADA-compliant temporary walkway to maintain pedestrian continuity.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the existing walkways to provide a level, unobstructed path for all users.

interventions.title: Street Lighting Installation
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety along this narrow corridor.

interventions.title: Utility Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate the utility pole or move the lines underground to clear the pedestrian walkway.

interventions.title: Driveway Warning Systems
interventions.description: Install mirrors or audible/visual alerts to warn pedestrians of vehicles exiting the garage.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Repave and level the existing sidewalks to remove trip hazards and improve accessibility.

interventions.title: Clear Walkway Enforcement
interventions.description: Ensure that parked vehicles do not encroach on the narrow pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer/Planting Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to increase separation from vehicles.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Expand the sidewalk width to meet ADA standards, providing a clear walking path around existing obstructions.

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Resurface the roadway and repair sidewalks to eliminate trip hazards and improve accessibility.

interventions.title: Shared Street (Woonerf) Treatment
interventions.description: Design the street as a shared space with low speed limits and physical cues that prioritize pedestrians over vehicles.

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair the cracked and uneven pavement to provide a smooth and safe walking surface.

interventions.title: Clear Path Maintenance
interventions.description: Enforce regulations to ensure construction activities and debris do not obstruct the entire width of the street.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearing and Maintenance
interventions.description: Remove all non-permanent obstructions including ladders, boards, and trash to restore the full clear width of the walkway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearance
interventions.description: Implement policies or physical changes to ensure a clear, unobstructed walking path of at least 4 feet.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Leveling
interventions.description: Repair cracked sections and ensure a smooth, level walking surface to prevent trips.

interventions.title: Street Trees or Planters
interventions.description: Introduce street trees or small planters where space permits to provide a vertical buffer between pedestrians and the roadway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Repair
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalks to meet accessibility standards and repair damaged pavement to provide a smooth walking surface.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Install speed humps or other traffic calming measures to ensure vehicle speeds remain low on this narrow residential street.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near intersections or mid-block crossing points to improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Parking Management and Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near intersections and narrow points to clear the sidewalk and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Utility Pole Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate the utility pole to the furniture zone or underground the utilities to provide a clear, unobstructed pedestrian through-zone.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer
interventions.description: Install street trees or a planting strip between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical and psychological buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: Shared Street Designation
interventions.description: Formalize the space as a 'woonerf' or shared street with clear signage, low speed limits, and priority for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Lighting
interventions.description: Install wall-mounted or pole-mounted lighting to improve visibility and safety during evening hours.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks at the intersection to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance and Clearing
interventions.description: Implement regular trash collection and enforcement to keep narrow walkways clear of obstructions.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Add street trees where space permits to provide a buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway and improve the walking environment.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Introduce a furniture zone with street trees or low-level vegetation to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and traffic.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Where space permits, add planters or street trees to provide a vertical buffer and improve the pedestrian environment.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or furniture zone to provide physical separation between the walkway and the travel lane.
